# Brand Strategy Productization Blueprint

## Part 1 — Atomic Decomposition

**Deliverables**
- Brand audit (competitive + internal)
- Positioning statement
- Messaging pillars (3–5)
- Voice & tone guide
- Naming recommendation
- Tagline / verbal identity
- Visual direction brief (for handoff to designer)
- Brand guide PDF (compiled artifact)
- Internal rollout deck
- Customer/stakeholder insight report

**Time blocks**
- 60-min kickoff call
- 45-min stakeholder interview (per interview)
- 60-min customer interview (per interview)
- 90-min positioning workshop
- 60-min messaging workshop
- 60-min presentation/handoff call
- 30-min check-in call

**Access tiers**
- Async-only (email, 48hr response)
- Standard (email + scheduled calls, 24hr response)
- Priority (Slack/text, same-day response)

**Support levels**
- Fixed revision rounds (1 / 2 / unlimited within window)
- Post-engagement office hours (0 / 2 sessions / 30-day window)
- Async review of team's downstream work (none / one pass / ongoing)

**Customizations**
- Number of stakeholder interviews (0 / 3 / 6 / 10)
- Number of customer interviews (0 / 3 / 6)
- B2B vs. B2C vs. hybrid framing
- Internal-clarity-only vs. agency/designer-handoff-ready
- Category (established / emerging / rebrand / M&A)
- Verbal-only vs. visual-direction-included

---

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|-----------|------------------|--------|--------------|
| **Depth** | Research thoroughness | Light (audit + 3 interviews) / Standard (audit + 6 interviews + customer research) / Deep (audit + 10 interviews + 6 customer + category analysis) | Sprint pace blocks Deep |
| **Breadth** | Brand-system scope | Verbal-only (positioning + messaging) / +Voice (adds voice & tone) / Full system (adds naming + visual direction brief) | Naming requires +Voice minimum |
| **Pace** | Calendar | Sprint (2 weeks) / Standard (6 weeks) / Extended (10 weeks) | Sprint blocks Deep depth and 10+ interviews |
| **Format** | Delivery medium | Async (docs + Loom) / Hybrid (docs + scheduled calls) / Embedded (workshops + working sessions) | Async blocks workshops; Embedded requires Standard or Extended pace |
| **Support** | Revisions + post-engagement | 1 round, no follow-up / 2 rounds + 2 office hours / Unlimited within window + 30-day office hours | Unlimited requires Hybrid or Embedded format |
| **Handoff** | Downstream readiness | Internal-only / Designer-ready / Agency-ready with rollout deck | Agency-ready requires Full system breadth |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + Embedded format
- Async format + Workshops (Embedded)
- Naming add-on without +Voice breadth
- Agency-ready handoff without Full system breadth
- Unlimited support with Async format

---

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Lite — Positioning Sprint — **$6,500**
- **Configuration:** Depth: Light · Breadth: Verbal-only · Pace: Sprint (2wk) · Format: Hybrid · Support: 1 round · Handoff: Internal-only
- **Positioning:** For founders who know their offering but can't articulate it — walk out with positioning + messaging pillars in two weeks.
- **Pricing logic:** ~43% of flagship. Anchored against the cost of *bad* positioning (wasted ad spend, unclear sales calls) rather than against senior-strategist day rates. Entry point that pre-qualifies for Core.

### Core — Brand Guide *(flagship)* — **$15,000**
- **Configuration:** Depth: Standard · Breadth: +Voice · Pace: Standard (6wk) · Format: Hybrid · Support: 2 rounds + 2 office hours · Handoff: Designer-ready
- **Positioning:** For growth-stage companies who need a complete verbal brand system a designer can build against — senior-strategist depth at half the price of an agency engagement.
- **Pricing logic:** Held at existing anchor. Sits well below the $25–50K agency band for equivalent brand-strategy scope; the value story is *senior-strategist-only, no account layer*.

### Premium — Brand System + Embed — **$32,000**
- **Configuration:** Depth: Deep · Breadth: Full system · Pace: Extended (10wk) · Format: Embedded · Support: Unlimited within window + 30-day office hours · Handoff: Agency-ready with rollout deck
- **Positioning:** For rebrands, category creators, and M&A brand consolidations that need naming, visual direction, and an internal rollout — a full brand system priced below a consultancy retainer.
- **Pricing logic:** Below sum-of-parts (naming alone is often $15–25K; strategy engagement $20–30K = ~$45K if bought separately). Positioned against boutique consultancy retainers ($40–75K).

---

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
| Upgrade | Add |
|---|---|
| Depth: Light → Standard | +$3,500 |
| Depth: Standard → Deep | +$5,000 |
| Breadth: Verbal-only → +Voice | +$2,000 |
| Breadth: +Voice → Full system (adds naming + visual brief) | +$6,500 |
| Pace: Sprint → Standard | +$1,500 |
| Pace: Standard → Extended | +$2,500 |
| Format: Hybrid → Embedded | +$4,000 |
| Support: 1rd → 2rd + office hours | +$1,500 |
| Support: 2rd → Unlimited + 30-day | +$3,500 |
| Handoff: Internal → Designer-ready | +$1,500 |
| Handoff: Designer → Agency-ready + rollout deck | +$3,000 |

**Floor:** $6,500 (Lite base — below this, refer to a workshop product or decline)

**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium flagship or custom scoping call.

**Configurator dependencies (enforced):**
- Sprint pace disables Deep depth and Embedded format
- Async format disables Unlimited support and Embedded workshops
- Naming/Full system requires +Voice minimum
- Agency-ready handoff requires Full system breadth

**Flagship-protection rule (verified):**
- BYO summed to Core config: $6,500 + $3,500 (depth) + $2,000 (breadth) + $1,500 (pace) + $1,500 (support) + $1,500 (handoff) = **$16,500** vs. Core flagship **$15,000** ✓
- BYO summed to Premium config: $6,500 + $3,500 + $5,000 + $2,000 + $6,500 + $1,500 + $2,500 + $4,000 + $3,500 + $1,500 + $3,000 = **$39,500** vs. Premium flagship **$32,000** ✓

Flagships remain the rational discount at every tier.

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Depth | How individualized programming + review are | Template-adjusted / Custom / Fully bespoke + form review | Fully bespoke requires intake call |
| Breadth | What's included beyond training | Training only / +Nutrition / +Lifestyle & habits | Lifestyle requires ≥ Custom depth |
| Pace | Adjustment frequency | Monthly / Biweekly / Weekly | Weekly requires 24hr-or-better access |
| Format | Live vs. async | Async-only / Async + monthly call / Async + weekly call / Live-coached sessions | Live-coached blocks Async-only pricing |
| Support | Access + response time | 48hr async / 24hr async / Same-day Voxer / Direct extended-hours | Direct extended-hours caps client count — Premium only |
| Accountability Mechanism *(domain-specific)* | How adherence is enforced | Passive (client logs) / Active (coach reviews weekly) / High-touch (daily check-ins) | High-touch requires Same-day Voxer or better |
| Add-ons | À la carte | Form-check pack · Peak week / event prep · Travel protocol · Bloodwork review interpretation | Peak week requires ≥ Custom depth |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Weekly adjustment pace + 48hr async support
- Lifestyle breadth + Template-adjusted depth
- Live-coached format without intake call
- Peak week add-on on Template-adjusted depth
- High-touch accountability + Async-only format

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

| Tier | Configuration | Positioning | Pricing anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Lite — Self-Driven** | Template-adjusted depth · Training-only · Monthly pace · Async-only · 48hr response · Passive accountability | For self-motivated lifters who want a real coach's programming without hand-holding | +$A/mo — entry point below typical 1-on-1; competes with app-based coaching (Future, Caliber ~$150–200/mo) |
| **Core — Coached** *(flagship)* | Custom depth · Training + Nutrition · Biweekly pace · Async + monthly call · 24hr response · Active accountability | For committed clients who want a real coaching relationship without live-session logistics | +$B/mo — sits at the center of the 1-on-1 online coaching market; the offer most clients should buy |
| **Premium — High-Touch** | Fully bespoke + form review · Training + Nutrition + Lifestyle · Weekly pace · Async + weekly call (or live-coached) · Same-day Voxer or Direct · High-touch accountability | For clients with a specific goal, tight timeline, or high accountability need (competitors, execs, event prep) | +$C/mo — priced against your capacity constraint, not a market comp; client count is the hard limit |

**Build-Your-Own framework**

- **Base price:** Lite (+$A/mo)
- **Per-dimension upgrades:** each dimension bump adds a fixed increment (e.g., Depth: Template → Custom = +$X; Pace: Monthly → Biweekly = +$Y; Support: 48hr → 24hr = +$Z; Format: +monthly call = +$Q; +weekly call = +$Q×2)
- **Floor:** Lite base — no configuration below this ships
- **Ceiling:** Any config combining Weekly pace + Same-day-or-better support + Fully bespoke depth auto-routes to Premium (or custom quote if exceeded)
- **Configurator-enforced dependencies:** all rules from Part 2's invalid-combinations list
- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing your way up to Core's configuration must total ~15–20% more than Core's flat price; same for Premium. Flagships remain the rational discount; BYO is for clients who want a specific non-standard mix (e.g., Custom depth + Monthly pace + Same-day Voxer — a config no tier offers cleanly).

- **Base price:** Lite = +$A
- **Per-dimension upgrades:**

This skill doesn't apply to your offering.

**Why:** Intelligent Clay productizes *services* — consulting, coaching, agency work, done-for-you engagements. The core problem it solves is turning custom human labor into configurable packages. SaaS is already modular by construction: you have seats, features, usage limits, and plan tiers as your atomic units. Applying service-decomposition logic here would produce worse structure than what pricing-page and packaging frameworks built for software already give you.

**What you actually want, depending on the real question underneath:**

- **Plan/tier restructuring** (are Free/Pro/Enterprise the right cuts?) — look into value-metric selection (per-seat vs. per-project vs. per-usage) and the Openview / Kyle Poyar SaaS pricing playbook.
- **Feature packaging across tiers** (what's in Pro vs. Enterprise, what's an add-on?) — feature-value matrices and the "leaders / fillers / feature-fences" framework.
- **Enterprise productization** (making custom deals less custom) — this is the *one* place a service-productization lens partially applies, but only to your implementation/onboarding/CSM motion, not the software itself. If that's the real question — "our Enterprise deals involve too much custom services work" — come back and describe *that services layer* and I'll apply the skill to it.
- **Usage-based / hybrid pricing model design** — separate discipline again; look at metering and the shift from seat-based to consumption models.

**If you want to proceed here:** tell me which of the above is the actual pain. If it's the Enterprise-services-wrapper problem, I can run the full blueprint on that slice.

This is out of scope for **intelligent-clay**.

You're selling a **physical product**, not a service. There's no time, labor, access, or process to atomize on the customer's side — they buy a finished object. The skill's decomposition logic (deliverables, time blocks, access tiers, support levels) doesn't map.

## What you likely want instead

**SKU + bundle + configurator logic**, which is a different discipline:

- **Variants** — leather type, thread color, size, card slots, monogram
- **Bundles** — wallet + cardholder + keychain sets
- **Tiers via materials/craftsmanship** — standard leather / premium hide / exotic (this is closest to what you're imagining, but it's SKU tiering, not service productization)
- **Made-to-order configurator** — customer picks options, price adjusts

## When to come back to me

If you ever add a **service layer** — e.g., custom design consultations, corporate gifting programs with branding services, repair/restoration subscriptions, leathercraft workshops — *that* portion is productizable with this skill.

For the wallets themselves, look for a skill focused on **e-commerce merchandising**, **product-line architecture**, or **configurator UX for physical goods**.

This is a **hybrid offering** (SaaS + service). Per the skill, the $99/mo SaaS is one fixed atom — I'm decomposing the $2,500 implementation service only.

*Assuming enterprise onboarding for a mid-market B2B SaaS (10–200 seat deployments); will re-anchor with tighter $ figures once you name the product category (e.g., HRIS, revenue ops, data platform) since implementation norms vary 3–5x across these.*
